diagnosis: Pancreatic neuroendocrine carcinoma (PanNEC), small cell type
legend: Pattern of poorly cohesive small tissue fragments, few intact dispersed single cells, stripped nuclei, and apoptosis, with tumour cells showing a high N:C ratio, nuclear moulding, and abnormal mitoses (Giemsa).

diagnosis: Pancreatic neuroendocrine carcinoma (PanNEC), large cell type
legend: The crowded large cells with pleomorphic nuclei show coarse chromatin, prominent nucleoli, and single cell necrosis with apoptotic debris (Pap).

diagnosis: Pancreatic neuroendocrine carcinoma (PanNEC), large cell type
legend: Cell block showing a tissue fragment composed of large cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm and bizarre pleomorphic nuclei, a suggestion of a pseudorosette pattern, and apoptosis (H&E).

diagnosis: Pancreatic neuroendocrine carcinoma (PanNEC), large cell type
legend: Neuroendocrine carcinomas (NECs) have a high Ki-67 index; here, it is approximately 50% (ICC).
Cell block showing tumour cells, which are small with a high N:C ratio and show nuclear moulding and moderate nuclear pleomorphism with some apoptosis (H&E).

Tumour cytomorphology is similar to that of small cell carcinoma of the lung, with nuclear moulding of small cells with hyperchromasia; a mix of fine and coarse, relatively uniformly distributed chromatin; scant cytoplasm; and apoptosis (Pap).
Very crowded tissue fragments of large, overtly malignant cells with a high N:C ratio, large nuclei with granular hyperchromatic chromatin, and scant cytoplasm (Giemsa).
